title: OverSire Groom
description: The result of a Groom session (OVERSIRE-336): the JSON object in the oversire-result block of its last message. The agent proposes a cleanup of the open items of one project. The app writes only the lines that the user selects.

GroomKind.description: Open set. merge: two or more items tell one problem, and keep stays. done: the code does it already. obsolete: the item is no longer valid, or it works against the vision. fold: the item is a part of parent. relate: add relation. vague: the item stays and needs Enhance. A decoder keeps an unknown kind. The app shows it as a line that it cannot apply.

GroomRelation.description: The relation of a relate line, seen from the item in keys.

GroomProposal.description: One line of the review. merge: keys has 2 or more keys, and keep is one of them. fold: keys has 1 key, and parent is set. relate: keys has 1 key, and relation is set.

keys.description: The items of the line, for example OVERSIRE-402.

parent.description: fold: the key of the new parent.

title.description: merge: a short name for the group.

evidence.description: Commits, pull requests, or a file and a line.

description.description: merge: the new description of keep, in Markdown.

skipped.description: The keys that the agent did not check.
